title: The Checking Account Cash Trap
hook_text: LEAVING $30,000 IN CASH BURNS $1,500 A YEAR

beats.say: Leaving $30,000 in a standard checking account quietly burns $1,500 every year in lost yield.
beats.visual: Macro of paper banknotes drifting like pale jellyfish in a still dark pond, one warm lamp-bright bucket rising beneath them, low angle.

beats.say: That dead cash sits there losing ground to inflation every single month you sleep.
beats.visual: Overhead view of a sunken bank door half buried in silt, bubbles carrying small coins upward through green water.

beats.say: Why do millions of savers keep six months of emergency money where it earns zero?
beats.visual: Wide shot of an empty swimming pool floor with sunbeams slicing through the drain grate, long lens, silhouette.

beats.say: Most people assume your safety net has to sit in a basic checking account to stay safe.
beats.visual: Macro of a rusted padlock on a sunken wooden gate, tiny bubbles trickling from its keyhole, razor focus.

beats.say: That assumption creates massive inflation drag without adding a single ounce of actual security.
beats.visual: Worm's-eye view of a school of tiny silver fish drifting in a loose circle above a sleeping anchor, blue haze.

beats.say: So how do you keep your emergency cash completely liquid while actually beating inflation?
beats.visual: Extreme wide aerial of a flooded valley with a single glowing buoy marking a dark channel, teal water.

beats.say: Here is the Tiered Liquidity Rule that protects your cash and puts it to work.
beats.visual: Eye level through a drowned doorway where a school of tiny fish forms an arrow pointing toward bright surface light.

beats.say: Step one: keep just one month of bills in your checking account for daily expenses.
beats.visual: Close-up of a small glowing glass lantern jar resting on seabed sand, one coral branch leaning toward it.

beats.say: Step two: move the remaining five months into a high yield vehicle or short-term treasury.
beats.visual: Overhead flat view of a slow river of paper leaves flowing into a bright underwater spring, ripples of light.

beats.say: Your money stays fully accessible for emergencies while earning a real return instead of zero.
beats.visual: Low angle of a long glass tube of rising bubbles in dark water, each bubble catching a sunbeam, macro.

beats.say: Stop paying a stealth inflation tax on the cash you worked hard to save.
beats.visual: Silhouette of a sunken ladder climbing from the dark seabed toward a shimmering bright surface, wide shot.

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you.
beats.visual: Long lens of a lone glowing jellyfish drifting upward past a drowned stone arch, calm indigo water.

caption:
Your emergency fund is losing ground every day it sits in a zero-interest account. Use the Tiered Liquidity Rule to fix it.
